messages.author: da33143a8db60ce8
messages.subject: rstan plans
parts:
Hi all.  Just to confirm our conversation from the other day, this is my impression of the plan for rstan.

1.  rstan gets updated to 2.6.0 to correspond to the new Stan 2.6.
2.  rstan gets put on CRAN.
3.  We add in new function stan_mle().  I’m assuming this function gives point estimate, a matrix of simulations, and conf intervals and standard errors obtained via quantiles of the simulations.
4.  We add in new functions stan_lm(), stan_glm(), etc., as they become ready.  I’m assuming any of these functions would have the option to run in full Bayes or via (penalized) mle.
5.  We put stan_run() (or some updated version of this that also does parallelism) somewhere on mc-stan.org along with instructions in the rstan doc so that users can just do source(“http://…/stan_run.R”) or whatever to grab it (cos I know it can’t be on CRAN).

Is this all correct?  I assume item 1 goes first.  After that, I don’t quite know the planned order of 2,3,4,5.

See you
A
